crew.original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
crew.overview: After Port Royal is attacked and pillaged by a mysterious pirate crew, capturing the governor's daughter Elizabeth Swann in the process, William Turner asks free-willing pirate Jack Sparrow to help him locate the crew's ship—The Black Pearl—so that he can rescue the woman he loves.
crew.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

crew.overview: The fate of the galaxy rests in the hands of bitter rivals. One, James Kirk, is a delinquent, thrill-seeking Iowa farm boy. The other, Spock, a Vulcan, was raised in a logic-based society that rejects all emotion. As fiery instinct clashes with calm reason, their unlikely but powerful partnership is the only thing capable of leading their crew through unimaginable danger, boldly going where no one has gone before. The human adventure has begun again.
crew.title: Star Trek

details.biography:
Brian Sipe is an Emmy® award-winning makeup artist working professionally in the industry since 1989.  Hailing from the Pacific Northwest, he made the move to Los Angeles, CA, and has since developed his career travelling the world and creating the portfolio found throughout this site. He has worked prominently on feature films, television series, commercials, live events, and web series.

Information above via their homepage.
